integrity: The mathematical claim is supported by a symbolic all-order proof and a reproducible finite census through twelve vertices; finite verification is not substituted for the proof. No independent audit has been performed.
limitations: Finite weakly connected total unary maps represented as binary relations; not arbitrary directed graphs, disconnected maps, or a genuine function-symbol language. Earlier algorithmic work on unary algebra isomorphism was not available in full text; historical priority is provisional.
title: Counting-color rigidity of connected finite endofunctions
